reasoning_trace: Extracted the contamination functions from pr/head into a harness; timed strip_heredocs on an unterminated heredoc: 14 lines 0.012s, 16 0.042s, 18 0.166s, 20 0.690s (x4 per 2 lines). Traced the runner: run_trial deletes .jobs/<jid>.pgid (run-ablation.sh:1031) before post_run calls the grader (:996) with no timeout; the watchdog reads .pgid files only; TEST_TIMEOUT_S (:262) bounds docker test commands only; reap (:1194) waits forever.
finding: Nested quantifier under re.S backtracks exponentially on an unterminated heredoc in an agent-authored Bash command; nothing bounds the scan, so the trial and the batch hang.
critique: Each repetition must consume exactly one line; the runner must bound the grade step.

The [^\n]*\n at :1377 consumes the header line's redirect target.
finding: Every heredoc body and the rest of its header line are removed before the outside-path scan, including executed bodies (interpreters, unquoted $(...)) and redirect/pipe targets.
critique: Only a quoted-delimiter body written by a non-interpreter command is inert data.
remediation: Keep the header line; strip only quoted-delimiter bodies whose command word is not an interpreter; scan all other bodies with ABS_WORD; add AG hit cases.

finding: Quote parity treats an apostrophe inside a double-quoted string as an open quote, hiding every later single-component sensitive word.

remediation: Walk the text tracking quote state and escapes, or require the quote to open on the same word.
